title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/011 (comparative): proposed pool barrier formed partly by a bi-fold house wall
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Hastings District Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; F9/AS1 Residential Pool Barriers (first edition, effective 27 April 2017) as cited
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The owners have built a new house and propose a pool, with the barrier formed by boundary fences and house walls.
The part of the barrier at issue is a wall of the house with a bi-fold window.
The owners state the window sill height exceeds 1000 mm with no projections beneath it greater than 10 mm.
The owners' building consent application is ABA20260003.
Figure 1 shows the wall and bi-fold window from the proposed pool area.
Acceptable Solution F9/AS1 Residential Pool Barriers is cited (first edition).
